columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The timestamp (UTC) reflecting the time when the AI interaction occurred

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the AI interaction log entry

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: Date and time when the AI interaction occurred

columns.name: storedAt
columns.description: Date and time when the AI interaction log was stored

columns.name: eventType
columns.description: Step of the interaction this entry records (input, output, model_invocation_request, model_invocation_response, tool_invocation_request, tool_invocation_response)

columns.name: turnId
columns.description: Identifier that groups the events of one exchange

columns.name: surface
columns.description: Where in Miro the interaction started

columns.name: actor_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the actor that produced the AI interaction (actor.id)

columns.name: object_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Miro object involved in the AI interaction (object.id)

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the session that groups the events of one conversation (session.id)

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Actor that produced the AI interaction, as returned by the API, in JSON format

columns.name: object
columns.description: Miro object involved in the AI interaction, as returned by the API, in JSON format

columns.name: session
columns.description: Session information, as returned by the API, in JSON format

columns.name: model
columns.description: Model information (model invocation events only), as returned by the API, in JSON format

columns.name: tool
columns.description: Tool information (tool invocation events only), as returned by the API, in JSON format

columns.name: details
columns.description: Additional details about the AI interaction in JSON format; the structure varies by event type
